title.zh: 视频系列模型（目录期初）

summary.en: Async video SKUs: Omni Flash duration family, MiniMax H3 variants, Veo 3.1, Grok Imagine Video, LTX.
summary.zh: 异步视频 SKU：Omni Flash 时长族、MiniMax H3 变体、Veo 3.1、Grok Imagine Video、LTX。

body.en:
Video generation on OmniMux is primarily **async**:

- Create: `POST /v1/video/generations`
- Poll: `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

## Models in this baseline

| Model id | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `omni_flash` | Omni Flash base |
| `omni_flash-4s` / `-6s` / `-10s` | Duration-oriented Omni Flash SKUs |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | MiniMax H3 text-to-video |
| `minimax-h3-flf` | First/last-frame style I2V |
| `minimax-h3-fl2va` | FL2VA-oriented path |
| `minimax-h3-endframe` | End-frame reference I2V |
| `veo_3_1` | Veo 3.1 |
| `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Grok Imagine Video |
| `ltx2.3-kj` | LTX 2.3 family SKU |

## Documentation

See **Video series** and **Task management** in the API manual. Do not confuse task poll with content download paths.
body.zh:
OmniMux 视频生成以 **异步任务** 为主：

- 创建：`POST /v1/video/generations`
- 查询：`GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

## 本期初模型

| Model id | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| `omni_flash` | Omni Flash 基础 |
| `omni_flash-4s` / `-6s` / `-10s` | 按时长划分的 Omni Flash SKU |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | MiniMax H3 文生视频 |
| `minimax-h3-flf` | 首末帧类 I2V |
| `minimax-h3-fl2va` | FL2VA 路径 |
| `minimax-h3-endframe` | 尾帧参考 I2V |
| `veo_3_1` | Veo 3.1 |
| `grok-imagine-video-1.5` | Grok Imagine Video |
| `ltx2.3-kj` | LTX 2.3 系 SKU |

## 文档

见 API 手册 **视频系列** 与 **任务管理**。勿与内容下载路径混淆。
